{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|There's the grotty little dyzat! Get him!|Tooqui's Qulun camp pursuers|<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
'''Dyzats''' were unpleasant, verminous animals of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]].<ref name="AS" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission to Ansion]], the [[Qulun]] [[Qulun camp|camp]] pursuers of the small [[Gwurran]] [[Tooqui]] cursed the fleeing runt by invoking the dyzat's name.<ref name="AS" />
